item.title: Jersey Information Commissioner joins global effort to address AI misuse
item.description: ROBUST safeguards are needed to combat the growing prevalence of ‘deepfake’ imagery, as Jersey’s Information Commissioner has joined 61 other authorities in raising major concerns about the use of artificial intelligence. item.title: Spending on Special Educational Needs support rises by 120% over five years
item.description: SPENDING on providing support to children with Special Educational Needs has more than doubled in the past five years to £37.8m, the Education Minister has said.
